SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { respectRobotsTxt: false, ssrf: { allowlist: [{ type: "cidr", value: "127.0.0.0/8" }], denyPrivate: true, maxRedirects: 5 }, ssrfDenyPrivateExplicit: true };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
